scope: Full text read; narrow review of new op19 OPENAT/READ/FSTAT/CLOSE and its actual buffers, FD ownership, child-call protections and complete syscall payload recording.
checks: owned_file uses -1 as the sole empty sentinel. Actual descriptor0 is accepted and subsequently handled by >=0 checks. The HIA-visible token1 is mapped to the actual privately owned descriptor, never treated as an arbitrary external fd.

OPENAT requires no existing owned file, a positive complete RO path span, final NUL and exact selected O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC flags before the OS operation. Embedded earlier NUL is not newly rejected by mechanics; path policy remains in HIA.

READ validates actual destination slot>=4, writable permission, logical span and count<=SSIZE_MAX before the read. Exact signed result/errno and every successfully returned byte are recorded. An interrupted read is returned to HIA, not retried by this layer.

FSTAT validates the actual144-byte writable logical destination before zeroing/calling and records the exact144 bytes, including failure state, with actual signed return and errno. sizeof(struct stat)==144 is a real startup guard.

CLOSE consumes owned_file before invoking close, including error paths. There is no hidden retry. Fatal cleanup consumes any still-owned file once; process termination is the stated final cleanup boundary.

call_image validates distinct actual slot descriptors, all logical extents and RO input / RW output+workspace, with guard checks before and after. Role2 workspace and second output cannot target controller slots0..3. Temporary input RO is restored on successful return; fatal paths terminate the process.

Every raw op19 produces an8-word actual receipt with raw fd before/after, signed result, errno and logical answer, followed by the complete path/read/stat payload. No truncated or reserialized raw payload is substituted.

Successful terminal requires no owned file, a valid RO final result view and exact sequence. BAD terminal may still own a file; its subsequent cleanup is explicitly recorded, rather than described as a successful HIA CLOSE.
bounded_scope_notes: This C executable is a development measurement/carrier, not the installed native TCB or an external namespace-authority issuer.
The fixed64 logical slots, two role images, mapping policy and role/controller semantics were not newly proven here.

Per-entry image trace records header windows; this review does not claim it contains every intermediate full workspace. It does contain full syscall payloads and final complete slot bytes as the source states.
No proof of whole process-tree CPU accounting is supplied by this source alone; the parent harness must retain its original90/180 and child cleanup controls.
